place.name: Department of Moquegua
place.description: Moquegua (Spanish pronunciation: [moˈkeɣwa] ; Mukiwa (Aymara); Muqiwa (Quechua)) is a department of Peru. It is located in the country's south, extending from the coast to its highlands.
